snippet.title: DAVE THE DIVER X Subnautica 2 - DLC Reveal | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about DAVE THE DIVER X Subnautica: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5246570/

We're excited to share the first trailer for the next DAVE THE DIVER DLC - a crossover with Subnautica 2!

DAVE THE DIVER dives into the world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure!

Join Dave and Bancho as they explore the mysterious ocean covered moon, where every strange new creature is a discovery for Dave and a new ingredient for Bancho. Make new discoveries beneath the surface and lend a hand to new friends along the way."

Wishlist the DAVE THE DIVER X Subnautica DLC now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5246570/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/dave-the-diver-ed092a
PlayStation: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/dave-the-diver/
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/dave-the-diver-subnautica-2-content-pack/9NCS77C7HCJD
Nintendo: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/dave-the-diver-switch/

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!
